Messages.Author: Frank Crins
Messages.Body:
Sunday the 3rd of november a fall Storyline-event will be held at the
'Spellenspektakel' in Eindhoven. It'll be a 2r+f tournament,
registration will be from aprox. 10:00 'till 11:00, play will start
shortly after that. Entrance-fee for the convention is not yet known.

Anyone interested to attend, can apply at fra...@dse.nl

Further info on the 'Spellenspektakel' can be found at
www.spellenspektakel.nl, info on the Storyline-event should be
available at www.white-wolf.com/vtes

Greetings,

Frank.
--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Nova_Arpad wrote:
>
> Question: Wat does 2R+F Tournament mean??

Two preliminary rounds (everyone plays - no elimination) followed
by a final round (in which the five players who garnered the most
Game Wins in the preliminary rounds play).
